name: Forearm Plank
description: The classic core hold: on your forearms and toes, keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

source.title: Front Plank (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Kneel on all fours, then lower onto your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach.
Don't let your hips sag or lift.
Look at the floor to keep your neck long.

prescription.note: Breathe steadily; build up the hold time gradually.

keyframes.name: Forearms and knees
keyframes.cue: Elbows under your shoulders, knees on the floor.

keyframes.name: Plank
keyframes.cue: Lift your knees and hold a straight line.
